utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — who’s picking up, and what time should I mark down?

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ve got a few options ready. Just tell me the days and times, and I’ll mark them down.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — just pass along the days when Vik circles back, and I’ll keep everyone posted. I’m happy to save spots for anyone who wants in!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll share the days as soon as Vik circles back.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sure — I’ll send the exact address so you can confirm it. It’s the one at my place, and I’ll make sure you have it before 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — what time are you thinking for pickup, and who’s dropping off?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I still need to check the pickup time and exact address. I’ll send those over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — just send the pickup time and address when you have them, and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — Tuesday and Thursday pickup are covered, so that’s a big help. I’ll pass along any changes if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Glad it’s covered. Just let me know if anything shifts with the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — thanks, Uli. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — thanks, Mina. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything that changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s stick with 8:15 sharp, and just bring your usual bag. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check with everyone and circle back so we can lock in the carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that works for me. Just keep me posted, and we’ll lock it in when everyone’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — 7:30 on weekdays works for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll pass along 7:30 on weekdays and see if everyone’s on board. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — keep me posted if the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — I just want to make sure the pickup time and route still work for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just to confirm, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow, and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, we’re still on for tomorrow — I just need the pickup time so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, there’s still room. 7:30 on weekdays still works.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — I’m in. Just let me know where to meet and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, 7:45 it is. I’ll see you there and we’ll have a little extra time before school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 7:45 works for me. I’ll be at the front curb.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll meet you at the front curb at 7:45.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do. I’d appreciate a clear plan as soon as you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll text you as soon as I know, and I’ll give you a clear ETA.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane — I’ll wait for your text and keep my morning open.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 at the school gate works for me. Who’s handling the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, 7:30 on weekdays works for me. Thanks, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ve got you down for 7:30 on weekdays. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll update the carpool list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — thanks for setting that up. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send the pickup time and exact address first? Then I can confirm the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I’ll send the pickup time and exact address now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’ll wait for the time and exact address, then I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts, but for now plan on 7:15. Glad you’re joining us!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, 7:15 works for me. Thanks for keeping me posted, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it, Cleo — I’ll see you at 7:15, and I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what pickup time works for you, and should we keep the same route?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 7:30 works for me, and the Maple to Oak route is fine.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, I’ll keep 7:30 and the Maple to Oak route. Thanks for confirming — I’ll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: What time are we aiming for, and should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time should I be ready? And if you need me to bring anything, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s plan on 7:30, and you don’t need to bring anything unless you want to.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — the carpool’s still open, and we’re leaving in a few minutes. I’m repeating the plan to everyone now so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Vik — I’ll let Mia and Ben know right now. I’ll make sure Dane gets the update too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep everyone posted and lock in the carpool plan once I’ve checked in with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:30 at your place works for me — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, 7:30 at my place it is — I’ll let everyone know. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — see you at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, 7:45 it is — thanks, Noah. See you then, and we’ll have a little extra time before school.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes — Tuesday morning still works for me. I’ll be there at 7:45.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Tuesday at 7:45 then — thanks, Rey. See you both in the morning!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ve got carpool set for 7:30 by the front curb and pickup at 3:15 by the school gate.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’ll pass that along. 7:30 by the front curb and 3:15 at the school gate, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right — 7:30 by the front curb and 3:15 at the school gate.

injected.text: Update: the morning carpool now leaves at 8am from the church parking lot, not 7am from the school lot.
